text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I can already picture 
the happy faces on my little sisters!
choice_data_list: I wanted to get one for you too, but...
I wanted to get yours too, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? You were thinking about all that 
for me!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just knowing how you feel makes me 
more than happy enough!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now, I gotta send this to my little 
sisters right away! Of course, I'll tell 
them that you won it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure they'll come to thank you, so 
please make sure to talk to them when they 
do!"
